questions.text: Does the document provide well-sourced evidence to justify its climate targets and actions?
questions.answer: The document provides well-sourced evidence to justify its climate targets and actions. The plan was developed through an extensive consultation process, indicating a strong preference for ambitious emissions reduction targets. This approach is in line with the C40 network, which is committed to addressing climate change.
